reader.requirement: At --std 85, in every DIVIDE format (1-5) each identifier (divisor, dividend, INTO receiver) must reference an elementary numeric item, and the GIVING identifier-3 and REMAINDER identifier-4 may also be an elementary numeric edited item; a group, an alphanumeric item, a reference-modified slice, an index data item, or a numeric-edited item in a non-GIVING position must be refused, and the admitted forms must compute.
